stats_semantics.plans: Caller increments only active nonempty planning snapshots.
stats_semantics.attempts: Worker selection attempts for occupied victim with active snapshot.
stats_semantics.preferred: An eligible GPU-covered target selected, whether same as first baseline eligible or changed.
stats_semantics.changed: Selected preferred target differs from first baseline eligible target; subset preferred proves selection actually changed.
stats_semantics.fallback: No eligible covered target, legacy eligible target selected.
stats_semantics.published: Successful writeback publication to a preferred target; <= preferred.
stats_semantics.merge: Worker-local StatsDelta only, merged after existing barrier; off fields remain zero. attempts == preferred + fallback + unavailable; changed <= preferred; published <= preferred. No timing or observer witnesses added.
